title: 56-bit-VA gated Phase-0 Vandermonde Y-cluster joint-2X 6-window 1-chain split-word birthday search on secp256k1 at 123.345407733025038 (MX=8)

claims.statement: For uniform secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x w.p. >= 0.39 (Q=O outputs x=0). Coordinator 0 draws 128-bit RNDR u (GATE = 256 insns) and halts with no output unless u < K_GATE = 132889197636386312489176148930335175013 (p_gate = K_GATE/2^128 ~ 0.390526253), else running Phase-0 GF(1024) X-mining (E_mine <= 2^125.3432 insns, halting with no output via route.s psel if any pool selects < 4 valid 0 < A(V) - A(U) < 2^63 pairs in B_p; zero fallback padding) and q1 = 70,000,000,000 batches in G = 2048 groups (m_g = floor(q1*(g/2048)^(25/32))) on 2^66 generators (MX=8), 2^41 relays, 2^82 homes (CAP_H = 1,313,229,200,424,960). Opened-run lo_run >= 0.998908516996 (exact (K_GATE/2^128) * lo_run >= 0.3901 > 0.39, c21). Unconditional E_total = 256 + p_gate * E_run (charging Phase-0 aborts at E_mine + 0 Phase 1-4 work and E_exc at EXC_WORK = ceil(P_EXC * W_DET_MAX)) is <= 2^123.345407733025038 units of 1000 scalar AArch64 insns (E_run <= 2^124.701917 units, <= 66.5693 insns/leaf of S = 2^128.610916); memory <= 2^138.0002 B; pre <= 2^116.2652 units (in E_run); no advice or prior-verdict premises.

experiments.purpose: Checks Y-chain generation, MX=8 Phase-0 birthday 6-window 1-chain split-word leaf kernels incl. straddling close pairs (97-insn TFP4S_7 CHAIN, CORS7, two-BFXIL 169-bit labels, BIC JTB7, LKFOLD4), 56-bit-VA K1=64/K2B=128 machine with Y ring, wcnt/ydsp wait/dispatch, meter_skip_ok, Phase-0 xemit/dlvh/hhclr and psel collector/short-pool abort + mutant rejection, VA trace, gate, Vandermonde/CS, C132 fold bound, and certificate counts.
